spec.title: How do the optimisers compare on a third domain with different mathematics (plate-fin heat sink, natural convection, minimum mass)?
spec.hypothesis: On the four-variable heat-sink problem, whose evaluator is a closed-form fixed point with an interior optimum in fin pitch, CMA-ES and the member-response surrogate reach a lower median mass than the plain evolutionary algorithm at equal budget, as they did on the manipulator; the global surrogate and Bayesian optimisation again trail the evolutionary algorithm.
